transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Please avoid heavy work or lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information. I have another question: When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you are running out, your GP should be able to provide some more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s helpful to know, thank you. I’m also very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it’s mild and things just look brighter than usual, wear sunglasses outside. But if the bright light causes significant pain, or your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and we may need to assess it further. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I appreciate the advice. One last question: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's everything I wanted to ask. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered now. Thank you!

verdict.label: pass

Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered in turn 6: "But if the bright light causes significant pain, or your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and we may need to assess it further."
